tools.name: search_language_schools
tools.description: Search and rank language schools. Returns school_id, url, indicative from-price, and reviews. Prices are not a booking quote; call calculate_trip_price before quoting a total.

tools.name: search_destinations
tools.description: Search cities, countries, and school names. Use before search_language_schools to resolve place names to slugs.

tools.name: get_school_filters
tools.description: Valid filter values for search_language_schools (languages, countries, cities, course types, and other facets).

tools.name: get_school
tools.description: School briefing: profile, cancellation policy, reviews, image URLs, bookings_live flag, and optional hero image for chat UI. Requires school_id from search_language_schools.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: Live course catalogue for a bookings_live school (course ids, weeks, prices). Use returned course ids inside save_trip configuration.

tools.name: list_starting_dates
tools.description: Allowed course start dates (typically Mondays) for a school. Use startDate values in list_courses and configuration.startDate.

tools.name: list_accommodations
tools.description: Accommodation groups for a school. Use group ids in save_trip configuration (accommodationGroupId).

tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Details for one course id from list_courses (pricing rows, supplements, metadata).

tools.name: get_accommodation_details
tools.description: One group from list_accommodations (group_id): type, room_types, meal/board options, distance, amenities, age and min-stay rules, and week prices for startDate and currency. Use after list_accommodations, before save_trip or calculate_trip_price, or to answer questions about one option. Week prices

tools.name: calculate_trip_price
tools.description: Live checkout quote for a configuration. Not a booking. Call before create_booking and before telling the student a final price.

tools.name: save_trip
tools.description: Create or update a server-side trip draft. Returns trip_id, url, trip_url, and continue_url (/s/{id}) so the student can restore selections on Extralingo.com. Not a booking. Requires OAuth trips scope (Bearer token).

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: Load a saved trip by trip_id from save_trip. Returns continue_url for website handoff with configuration restored.

tools.name: email_trip
tools.description: Email continue_url (/s/{id}) to the verified account inbox. Requires OAuth trips scope. Rate-limited. Not a booking; you can share continue_url without emailing.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Submit an unpaid booking for a bookings_live school (same path as the website Book now flow). The school still confirms availability; Extralingo emails the student; down payment is due within 5 days of school confirmation via Extralingo only. Never tell the user they are confirmed or paid. Requires

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Ask the school for a personal quote when bookings_live is false or the student is not ready to book. Requires OAuth requests scope. Optional idempotency_key.

tools.name: request_discussion
tools.description: Trip discussion: trip_id or school_id+configuration plus message. ask_school_question: question without a trip. request_quote: personal quote (comments) when not booking. School gets the config; Extralingo emails the verified account and coordinates replies. Returns kind, newBookingId, redirectUrl,

tools.name: ask_school_question
tools.description: Send a question to the school without a full trip configuration. Requires OAuth requests scope. Optional idempotency_key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_language_schools, get_school · Private data: save_trip, create_booking · Public sink: email_trip, create_booking, ask_school_question.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_language_schools, get_school · Private data: save_trip, create_booking · Public sink: email_trip, create_booking, ask_school_question

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_language_schools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Returns school_id, url, indicative from-price, and reviews. Prices are not a booking quote; call calculate_trip_price before quoting a total."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
